result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured and visually intact. A couple of minor cosmetic inconsistencies were found, mostly related to the favorite (heart) buttons on restaurant cards.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the pizza card lacks the dark circular background seen on the ramen card's heart button, making it blend into the light pizza image and harder to notice/tap.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background treatment to the heart buttons across all cards so they remain visible over light imagery.

issues.description: The notification bell button sits vertically offset next to the delivery address, appearing slightly cramped against the 'DELIVER TO' block.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing between the address bar and the bell icon, or align them on the same row for a cleaner header.
